No, it did not produce the requested result. Calling `lci_info` with `{"tool":"definitely-not-a-tool"}` returned **usable data** — the general/default `info` overview (available tools list, quick_start, server/tagline, why_use_lci), not an error and not an empty/not-found result. The server appears to ignore the unknown tool name and fall back to the default overview rather than producing a tool-specific help entry.

Corrective guidance: to get help on a specific tool, pass one of the valid tool names (e.g., `search`, `files`, `get_context`, `context`, `list_symbols`, `inspect_symbol`, `browse_file`, `semantic_annotations`, `code_insight`, `side_effects`, `index_stats`, `debug_info`, `git_analysis`, `info`), or use `info version` for server info.
